note: Hooded rogue, front view. Head is the whole dark hood, face and beard, bottom edge y~410 at the chin/beard; the pink neck below the beard, cloak, coat, belt, pouches and the cloak tails at both sides are torso. Both arms are mostly hidden under the cloak; upper arms run from the shoulder (the right one carries a pauldron-like pad) to y582 where the dark sleeve meets the brown bracers, forearms are the brown bracers y582-647 (left) and y588-648 (right), and the hands are the bare fists below (left y~630-695, right y648-707). Each hand holds a dagger point-down and outward, labelled equipment: the left blade and its gold guard (x212-338), the right blade with its dark outline next to the fist (x686-806). Hip y~740 (coat hem over trousers); both boots have cuffs reaching above halfway, so knees are the boot tops (left y790, right y802), ankles at the instep (left y862, right y872).
